text.tspan: Retrieve DNA sequences from GenBank by accession or taxon query;
extract targeted loci from whole plastid/mitochondrial genomes.
Merge same-locus FASTA files, align with ClustalW/Muscle,
convert among FASTA, NEXUS and PHYLIP.
Keep a taxon subset across many alignments, trimming resulting
gap-only sites; relabel sequences via a lookup table.
Parse tip labels into genus, species, infraspecific epithet,
voucher and GenBank columns; abbreviate genus names.
Compare and concatenate multilocus alignments, matching taxa
structurally so identifiers need not match verbatim across loci.
Write partitioned NEXUS/PHYLIP matrices keeping differing
identifiers as bracketed comments; select models; build MrBayes blocks.
Run/stop MrBayes directly from R; edit and visualize the
